zh.title: 聯合航空將於休士頓部署「Elevated」波音787-9客機 涵蓋四條洲際航線
zh.summary: 聯合航空（United Airlines）計劃自2026年第四季起，於其休士頓喬治布希洲際機場（IAH）樞紐的四條洲際航線部署採用「United Elevated」新客艙配置的波音787-9夢幻客機。此次調整屬既有航線的機型與客艙產品升級，並非新增航點或開闢新航線。
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）計劃自2026年第四季起，於其休士頓喬治布希洲際機場（IAH）樞紐的四條洲際航線部署採用「United Elevated」新客艙配置的波音787-9夢幻客機。此次調整屬既有航線的機型與客艙產品升級，並非新增航點或開闢新航線。
依最新航班時刻資料，休士頓往返巴西聖保羅瓜魯柳斯國際機場（GRU）、日本東京成田國際機場（NRT）及澳洲雪梨金斯福德·史密斯機場（SYD）的航班，預定自2026年10月24日起改由此一新版787-9執飛。休士頓往返英國倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）的UA880及UA879航班，則預計自2027年1月5日起導入該機型。

聯合航空的「Elevated」787-9採222席配置，為該公司高端座位比例較高的廣體客機版本。客艙設有8席Polaris Studio商務艙套房、56席Polaris商務艙、35席Premium Plus豪華經濟艙、39席Economy Plus加大腿部空間經濟艙與84席經濟艙，其中Polaris Studio設於商務艙前排，提供較大的個人空間、隱私門、27吋4K OLED螢幕及可供同行旅客使用的腳凳座位。 標準Polaris商務艙同樣配備可全平躺座椅、隱私門與19吋4K螢幕；Premium Plus與經濟艙則導入更大的座椅螢幕及藍牙連線功能。聯合航空在2026年3月公布首架Elevated 787-9的商業部署計畫，首批國際航線為舊金山國際機場（SFO）往返新加坡樟宜機場（SIN）及倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）。
休士頓是聯合航空在美國的重要轉機樞紐之一，服務拉丁美洲、歐洲、亞洲與澳洲等長程市場。隨著此次部署，休士頓將成為繼舊金山後，另一個定期使用Elevated 787-9執飛國際航線的聯合航空樞紐；惟航空公司實際機型安排仍可能因營運調度而變更。

en.title: United Airlines to Deploy "Elevated" Boeing 787-9 Aircraft in Houston Across Four Intercontinental Routes
en.summary: United Airlines plans to deploy Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner aircraft featuring the new "United Elevated" cabin configuration on four intercontinental routes from its Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) hub starting in the fourth quarter of 2026. This adjustment represents an aircraft and cabin product upgrade for existing routes rather than the addition of new destinations or routes.
body: United Airlines plans to deploy Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner aircraft featuring the new "United Elevated" cabin configuration on four intercontinental routes from its Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) hub starting in the fourth quarter of 2026. This adjustment represents an aircraft and cabin product upgrade for existing routes rather than the addition of new destinations or routes.

According to the latest schedule data, flights between Houston and São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport (GRU) in Brazil, Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT) in Japan, and Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport (SYD) in Australia are scheduled to transition to this new 787-9 variant effective October 24, 2026. Flights UA880 and UA879 between Houston and London Heathrow Airport (LHR) in the United Kingdom are expected to introduce the aircraft type starting January 5, 2027.

United Airlines' "Elevated" 787-9 features a 222-seat configuration, representing a widebody aircraft version with a higher proportion of premium seating. The cabin includes 8 Polaris Studio business class suites, 56 standard Polaris business class suites, 35 Premium Plus premium economy seats, 39 Economy Plus extra-legroom economy seats, and 84 standard economy seats, with Polaris Studio situated in the front row of business class to provide greater personal space, privacy doors, 27-inch 4K OLED screens, and ottoman seating for an accompanying travel companion. Standard Polaris seats are likewise equipped with lie-flat seats, privacy doors, and 19-inch 4K screens, while Premium Plus and Economy cabins feature larger seatback displays and Bluetooth connectivity. United Airlines announced its commercial deployment plan for the first Elevated 787-9 in March 2026, with initial international routes operating between San Francisco International Airport (SFO) and Singapore Changi Airport (SIN) as well as London Heathrow Airport (LHR).

Houston serves as one of United Airlines' major connection hubs in the United States, supporting long-haul markets across Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. With this deployment, Houston will become another United Airlines hub after San Francisco to regularly operate international routes using the Elevated 787-9; however, actual aircraft assignments by the airline remain subject to change due to operational scheduling.
